note_tweet.text:
瓦罗兰特新地图取景地为张家界！

抛开游戏性不谈，瓦的地图设计真的不错，细节到位，有好多小彩蛋可以挖掘，跟剧情关联度高(不过感觉没啥人关注瓦的剧情)，偏卡通画风真的喜欢
不知道这次设定怎么圆回来
A new map from Valoran has been released, set in Zhangjiajie. And it will be available before the championship!Regardless of the gameplay aspect, the map design of Va is really good. It has detailed elements, many hidden little treasures to discover, and a high degree of connection with the storyline (though it seems that not many people pay attention to Va's storyline). The cartoonish style is really appealing.
I wonder how this setting will be resolved this time.
